Title: MSP Process GDAP breach - ipv4
Description: Azure IP that used several partners' stolen MSP Process app secrets to get Microsoft Graph tokens within seconds on 7 Nov 2026 (11:30–11:31 UTC), reported by Inforcer and Huntress. Source: Inforcer – When a GDAP vendor is breached, check your own tenant https://www.inforcer.com/insights/when-a-gdap-vendor-is-breached-check-your-own-tenant
RecommendedActions: Isolate host, investigate process tree and persistence; rotate credentials if confirmed.
